security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Build data analyses visually, in SQL, Python and R
bundle.longDescription: Build an analysis as a pipeline of steps: visual steps, SQL, Python and R, each with its result beside it, in a notebook you can share. Projects are plain folders, and vda-run refreshes them on a schedule without the app.
